chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Shaybani, and Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qattan, and al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Ahmad ibn Hisham al-Muaddib, and Ali ibn Abdullah al-Warraq, and Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Musa ibn Imran al-Daqqaq said: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Zakariya al-Qattan narrated to us, saying: Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Habib narrated to us, saying: Tamim ibn Buhlul narrated to us from his father, from Abu al-Hasan al-Abdi, from Sulayman ibn Mahran, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his Family) was one day in the Mosque of Quba, and with him were some of his companions. He said: 'The first to enter upon you at this hour is a man from the people of Paradise.' When they heard this, some of them stood up and left, and each one of them wished to return so that he might be the first to enter, thereby earning Paradise. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his Family) knew this of them, so he said to those who remained with him from his companions: 'Indeed, a group will enter upon you who will race (to be first). The one who gives me glad tidings of the coming of March, for him is Paradise.' The people returned, and Abu Dharr (may Allah be pleased with him) entered with them. He said to them: 'In which month of the Roman months are we now?' Abu Dharr said: 'March has come, O Messenger of Allah.' He (peace be upon him and his Family) said: 'I know that, O Abu Dharr, but I wanted my people to know that you are a man from the people of Paradise. And how could that not be? You will be expelled from my sanctuary after me due to your love for my Household, and you will live alone and die alone, and a people will be happy with you who will manage your preparation and burial! Those are my companions in the Paradise of Eternity that has been promised to the Godfearing.'

key_terms.آذَار: Adhar, a Roman month corresponding to March
key_terms.أَبُو ذَرٍّ: Abu Dharr, a prominent companion known for his asceticism and love for the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ: People of Paradise, referring to those destined for Jannah
key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتِي: My Household, referring to the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.الْمَطْرُودُ: The expelled one, referring to the exile or separation from the Prophet's presence
key_terms.حَرَمِي: My sanctuary, referring to the Prophet's domain or presence
key_terms.رَفَقَائِي: My companions, those who will be with the Prophet in Paradise
key_terms.مَسْجِدُ قُبَاءٍ: Mosque of Quba, the first mosque built by the Prophet in Medina

ai.seo_question: What is the story behind the Prophet's promise of Paradise to the one who announces the arrival of March?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* highlights the Prophet’s (SAW) use of a subtle test to publicly affirm Abu Dharr al-Ghifani’s status as *Ahl al-Bayt* due to his deep love for them. The specific mention of 'Adhar' (March) and the subsequent prediction of Abu Dharr’s solitary exile and death underscores the Shia concept of *Walayah* as the criterion for Paradise, linking his piety directly to his devotion to the Prophet's Household.
